intended_object: The free product (coproduct in the category of not-necessarily-commutative R-algebras) of a family of R-algebras A i, presented as a quotient of the direct sum of tensor powers of ⨁ i, A i. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: `asPowers` is the quotient of `PowerAlgebra R A` (⨁ n, the n-th tensor power of ⨁ i, A i) by the ring congruence generated by `rel'`. `rel'` is `rel` (identify each unit 1ᵢ with 1, and aᵢ ⊗ aᵢ' with aᵢaᵢ') pulled back along the algebra isomorphism `ofDirectSum` to the tensor algebra. The congruence generated by that pullback is the pullback of `ringCon`, so the quotient is isomorphic to `LinearAlgebra.FreeProduct`, the presentation by generators and relations of the coproduct of R-algebras. The file proves this right afterwards as `asPowersEquiv`. The generality is natural: any index type with decidable equality (needed for the direct sum), a commutative semiring R, and semiring R-algebras. It is an equivalent alternative model of the free product, so it is faithful.
